label: Whatever directs a natural body to an end, some director of that body…, by Well-founded-induction
meaning: Along the per se series: a moved director is moved by another (reduction), not by itself (no act and potency in the same respect), and that mover directs the body to the same end through it (open bridge STMT-DIRECTION-THROUGH-INTERMEDIARIES, supported by q.103 a.6); a moved mover of it moves only as moved (per se link), and the per se series has no infinite descent (prima via). Excluded middle decides at each step whether the director is moved.
